ModMetaData.name: Undergrounders: Wortwart
ModMetaData.author: BattIeBear
ModMetaData.description:
V1.6
This mod adds a new type of fungus, wortwart, which, as the name suggests, can be turned into wort at a brewery. Like most fungi, it must be grown in complete darkness.
Found an issue? Like my mod? Leave a comment!
